**About Avoca**
Avoca is transforming how home service companies engage with their customers. Our AI-powered conversational agents handle every high-value inbound call, from booking jobs, qualifying leads, and driving higher revenue, all at a speed and consistency unmatched by human call centers.
  
  
We're a Series B startup backed by Kleiner Perkins, Meritech Capital, General Catalyst, and other top-tier investors, with $125M raised and a $1B valuation. We grew 10x in 2025 and have scaled to 170+ employees in under two years across our NYC headquarters and Santa Barbara office.
  
  
In a $1T+ market where 85% of missed calls go to competitors, we're building the category-defining platform for AI-driven customer engagement, serving the largest brands in home services. With high-energy, in-office teams in both locations, every hire here has an immediate and visible impact.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Forward Deployed Product Engineer, you'll embed directly with the largest brands in home services — learning how their businesses actually run, then designing and shipping the AI systems that run their front lines. This isn't a solutions role where you hand off specs and stop coding: you own the build end-to-end, from the first customer conversation to a live deployment handling real call volume. And because you have the deepest view of what customers actually encounter, what you learn in the field feeds directly into our core product roadmap.
  
  
**Recent recognition:**

* Build production integrations into customer CRM/FSM systems (APIs, webhooks, and data flows) plus the monitoring and feedback loops that keep them healthy.
* Translate messy, real-world business requirements into clean technical architecture and shipped code.
* Spot patterns across deployments and turn them into reusable tooling and product improvements that scale beyond a single customer.

* Bonus: LLMs, prompt engineering, AI agent frameworks, vector databases, or voice/telephony infrastructure — and an eye for how LLM systems shape user experience.

**Your first 6 months**

We're looking for a Full Stack Engineer to join our Platform and Internal Tools team, the team responsible for services connecting third-party systems and data sources to product surfaces, as well as internal tooling for clinical providers and patient care coordinators. This team plays a pivotal role in Talkiatry's mission by creating and maintaining the technical infrastructure and tooling that allows us to efficiently match and book patients with providers, support providers in delivering great care, and allow our staff to quickly and effectively assist patients with problems. As an engineer on this team, you'll work on the problems involved in improving and optimizing healthcare delivery. You'll co-own systems that synchronize patient data across multiple platforms and data sources, solve integration challenges, and build tools that clinicians depend on to manage their patients and their day. You'll collaborate closely with product, design, and data to design and build reliable, extensible, and maintainable systems in TypeScript across both backend and frontend (running on AWS). Our team lives by the motto penned by Piet Hein: "Problems worthy of attack prove their worth by hitting back"—and that’s the kind of problems we like to solve. The challenges are meaningful precisely because patient care depends on getting them right.




ABOUT TALKIATRY: 

Talkiatry is transforming mental health care by making high-quality psychiatry more accessible, human, and sustainable for both patients and clinicians. Co-founded by a patient and a triple-board-certified psychiatrist, we were built to solve one of healthcare’s most urgent challenges: millions of people struggle to access mental health care, while clinicians face growing administrative burden and burnout. Through our technology-powered, in-network platform, we’re changing that, creating a better experience for patients and empowering clinicians to focus on delivering exceptional care.

 

Today, Talkiatry is the largest dedicated psychiatry practice in the U.S., with 900+ psychiatrists, 400+ therapists, and more than 4 million patient visits delivered nationwide. At our scale, every innovation has real impact. Every workflow we improve, every technology solution we build, and every patient experience we redesign helps thousands of clinicians provide better care to hundreds of thousands of patients. We’re not just growing quickly — we’re redefining how behavioral healthcare is delivered in America.

 

Joining Talkiatry means joining a mission-driven team that is solving complex problems at scale, driving meaningful change in healthcare, and building the future of mental health care with compassion, innovation, and purpose.




YOU WILL:

 - Contribute to the design, development, and rollout of core technical features and large-scale initiatives that directly impact the efficiency and quality of patient care.

 - Write clear technical specifications, define architecture, and identify risks before project kickoffs.

 - Take part in engineering best practices—including code reviews, documentation, testing, and postmortems—to improve team efficiency and code quality.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and analysts to translate business needs into actionable, measurable features.

 - Contribute across the stack: from building robust backend services and APIs to creating intuitive frontend tooling in React/TypeScript.

 - Drive simplicity and scalability in system design to maintain reliability and implementation velocity.

 - Mentor teammates and take active parts in high-impact initiatives.




YOU HAVE:

 - 1-3+ years of professional software development experience.

 - Expertise in TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks.

 - Experience building backend services in TypeScript (Node.js, Express, or similar).

 - Demonstrated ability to deliver complex projects from design through production.

 - Experience collaborating with product and other engineering teams, measuring outcomes, and iterating quickly.

 - Excellent communication and documentation skills.

 - A bias for reducing complexity, improving systems, and mentoring others.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Familiarity with Nest JS.

 - Familiarity with healthcare, telehealth, or regulated industries.

 - Comfort working in a fast-paced environment.




WHY TALKIATRY:

 - Top-notch team: we're a diverse, experienced group motivated to make a difference in mental health care

 - Collaborative environment: be part of building something from the ground up at a fast-paced startup

 - Excellent benefits: medical, dental, vision, effective day 1 of employment, 401K with match, generous PTO plus paid holidays, paid parental leave, and more!

 - Grow your career with us: hone your skills and build new ones with our Learning team as Talkiatry expands

BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building academic or personal projects involving machine learning or recommendation systems.

 - Experience working with SQL, real-world datasets, or user interaction data.

 - Familiarity with deep learning frameworks, model evaluation, or experimentation.

 - A personal interest in music, music discovery, or social platforms.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Hands-on experience building and improving real-world recommendation and personalization systems.

 - The opportunity to work on the full ML development lifecycle, from data processing and model development to evaluation and product integration.

 - Exposure to practical engineering challenges involving recommendation algorithms, ranking, retrieval, and personalization.

 - Close collaboration with experienced teammates across engineering, research, and product.

 - Mentorship and opportunities to develop strong machine learning and software engineering skills.

 - The freedom to experiment with new approaches, technologies, and ML architectures.

 - The opportunity to make a direct impact on how millions of people could discover, interact with, and experience music.
